slides.label: Verse 1
lines: Hallelujah, Hallelujah
Hallelujah, Hallelujah

slides.label: Verse 2
lines: You’re the One all creation adores
All dominion, might, and power are Yours
You are God in the highest
Your throne is forever
We bless You, holy God
In all the earth

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: Hallelujah, Hallelujah, Hallelujah
Hallelujah, Hallelujah, Hallelujah
We bless You, holy God

slides.label: Verse 4
lines: The cherubims spread their wings in worship
the seraphims cry holy before You

slides.label: Verse 5
lines: The thrones bow in worship before Your holiness
The hosts of heaven and earth
Adore Your loveliness You are most holy

slides.label: Verse 6
lines: Holy, oh God, You are
Lord, You’re majestic in all Your ways
Hallowed is Your name
In heaven and earth for eternity

slides.label: Verse 7
lines: Holy, oh God, You are
Lord, You’re majestic in all Your ways
Hallowed is Your name
In heaven and earth for eternity

slides.label: Verse 8
lines: Your goodness and mercy are endless
Your judgments are ever righteous
Glorious is Your might, the only true God

slides.label: Verse 9
lines: The echoes of Your wonders
Are for all eternity, You are most holy

slides.label: Verse 10
lines: You preside over the council of Your holy ones
God of the angel armies
The glory of Your faithfulness
is for all generations

slides.label: Verse 11
lines: The oceans swell with Your praise
The endless fountains of Your love
Spring forth Your splendor

slides.label: Verse 12
lines: Holy, oh God, You are
Lord, You’re majestic in all Your ways
Hallowed is Your name
In heaven and earth for eternity

slides.label: Verse 13
lines: Creator of all things
Time and eternity, The Eternal Being
In whom eternity resides

slides.label: Verse 14
lines: You dwell in the highest place of endless glory
The deepest depth below trembles at Your presence
The glory of Your presence far surpasses
The widest width and farthest beyond

slides.label: Verse 15
lines: Great King and God of all the heavens and the earth
Your dynasty reigns through all
Hallelujah to the Most High God, Hallelujah

slides.label: Verse 16
lines: Hallelujah, Hallelujah, Hallelujah
Hallelujah, Hallelujah, Hallelujah
Hallelujah, Hallelujah, Hallelujah
